page_title: STU 0-0 HOF | Stuttgart v Hoffenheim 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The goal by Stuttgart is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+3' The Stuttgart players joy may have been justified, because referee Daniel Siebert is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+2' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

90+1' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Stuttgart, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
90' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off his line to gather the ball.
89' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Tim Lemperle is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim).
88' Alexander Prass comes off the pitch to be replaced by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
87' Fouls committed – 10:15.
84' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

84' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Stuttgart.
83' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) picks out Jamie Leweling with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
82' The attendance for today's match is 59000.
79' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

78' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
74' 9:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
73' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Albian Hajdari and he is replaced by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim).

73' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.

71' What a miss! Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
70' What a chance that is! Maximilian Mittelstadt swings the ball into the box, and Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Tiago Tomas.

69' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the left side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann makes a nice save.
68' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
67' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) brings his opponent down. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
66' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
65' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender.
65' That's the end of the game for Fisnik Asllani, who is replaced by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
61' Daniel Siebert blows for a foul after Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

59' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Alexander Nubel was alert and the score remains the same.
58' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
57' Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. Hoffenheim get a free kick.
55' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) plays a terrific long ball forward to Fisnik Asllani, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.

54' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
51' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
48' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Sebastian Hoeness gives a chance to Ameen Al Dakhil and Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post.
43' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared.

42' Oliver Baumann pulls off a great save to deny Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.
41' The corner kick is deflected to Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
41' The corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared away by the defence.
41' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart). Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.
39' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim), who has already been caught several times today.
35' The cross into the penalty area from Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
32' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
31' Total attempts – 1:2. The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
25' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
25' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.
23' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
20' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
17' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and it's Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' The possession of the ball – 54:46.
15' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
13' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Daniel Siebert stops the game and makes a call.
12' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) sends a long cross over to Alexander Prass, but Alexander Nubel comes forward to gather the ball.
11' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
9' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

9' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) plays a long ball to Jamie Leweling, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
8' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
7' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.
5' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) tries to find Vladimir Coufal, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
5' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
Daniel Siebert was nominated as the referee for this game.
